CustomField.formula:
IF( OR( ISPICKVAL(Status, 'New'), ISPICKVAL(Status, 'Open'), ISPICKVAL(Status, 'Waiting on internal'), ISPICKVAL(Status, 'In Progress'), ISPICKVAL(Status, 'Closed'), ISPICKVAL(Status, 'Waiting on Customer') ), IMAGE( CASE(Status, 'New', 'https://iconssfdc.s3.eu-central-1.amazonaws.com/status-new.png', 'Open', 'https://iconssfdc.s3.eu-central-1.amazonaws.com/status-open.png', 'Waiting on Customer', 'https://iconssfdc.s3.eu-central-1.amazonaws.com/status-pending.png', 'Waiting on internal', 'https://iconssfdc.s3.eu-central-1.amazonaws.com/status-escalated.png', 'In Progress', 'https://iconssfdc.s3.eu-central-1.amazonaws.com/status-pending.png', 'Closed', 'https://iconssfdc.s3.eu-central-1.amazonaws.com/status-closed.png', '' ), '', 22, 22 ) + ' ' + CASE( $User.LanguageLocaleKey, 'fr', CASE(Status, 'New', 'Nouveau', 'Open', 'Ouvert', 'Waiting on internal', 'En attente interne', 'On Hold', 'En attente', 'In Progress', 'En cours', 'Closed', 'Fermé', 'Waiting on Customer', 'En attente du client', Text(Status) ), 'de', CASE(Status, 'New', 'Neu', 'Open', 'Offen', 'Waiting on internal', 'Warten auf Intern', 'On Hold', 'In Wartestellung', 'In Progress', 'in Bearbeitung', 'Closed', 'Abgeschlossen', 'Waiting on Customer', 'Warten auf Kunden', Text(Status) ), Text(Status) ), Text(Status) )
